info.title: LoneStarOracle — full catalog
info.description: Every LoneStarOracle pay-per-call data service in one document. Call any endpoint through the single base URL https://lonestaroracle.xyz/api/<service>/<path> (forwards to the service), or directly at its own host (x-direct-url on each operation). Paid endpoints return HTTP 402 with x402 payment requirements (USDC on Base or Solana); pay and retry. No API keys, no accounts. Price per call is in x-payment-info.
info.x-guidance: Agents: fetch this one document; do not crawl per-service hosts. Base URL https://lonestaroracle.xyz/api/<service>/<path> forwards to each service (x-direct-url on each operation is the same endpoint on its own host; both work). Every operation carries x-payment-info: authMode 'free' needs no payment; authMode 'payment' returns HTTP 402 with the requirements in the base64 'payment-required' response header (x402 v2; a v1 body is also sent for legacy clients). Pay USDC on Base (eip155:8453) or Solana and retry with the payment header; settlement happens only on a successful (2xx) response, so a 4xx such as an unknown category or a missing parameter is never charged. Query-parameter names are in each operation; common synonyms are accepted (e.g. ticker/symbol, country/location). Prices are fixed per call and listed in x-payment-info.price.amount (USD). info.version changes whenever any path, parameter, price or schema changes (x-content-hash is the sha256 of paths+components), so re-pull only when it moves. Flat list: https://lonestaroracle.xyz/catalog.json. Payment manifest: https://lonestaroracle.xyz/.well-known/x402. Contact: jay@lonestaroracle.xyz.
